findings.summary: NEGATIVE RESULT: Exhaustive search across all local document databases (DOJ Vol 11, Duggan, LMSBAND, Unified, Epstein 20K) found ZERO direct mentions of Republic National Bank of New York or Republic New York Corporation in Epstein's banking records, wire transfers, or correspondence. All 'Republic National Bank' phrase matches were false positives. No evidence of Epstein banking relationship with RNB. However, Jacqui Safra (Safra banking family) was a direct Epstein social associate.

SYNTHESIS: Republic National Bank / Safra investigation reveals a banking institution operating at the intersection of intelligence operations, organized crime exposure, and the Epstein network. Key convergences: (1) IRAN-CONTRA: Both RNB (NY) and Trade Development Bank (Geneva) served as conduits for Enterprise funds — RNB officer Nan Morabia delivered $150K cash to Adnan Khashoggi, TDB held Enterprise funds in 'Codelis' account (Walsh Report). (2) RUSSIAN ORGANIZED CRIME: RNB exposed $10B Bank of NY/Mogilevich money laundering (Aug 1998), Safra co-founded Hermitage Capital with Bill Browder (1996, $25M RNB seed). (3) SUSPICIOUS DEATH TIMELINE: Safra died in arson fire Dec 3, 1999 — between RNB's Mogilevich exposure and HSBC acquisition closing Dec 31, 1999. Nurse Ted Maher (Green Beret background) convicted. (4) EPSTEIN CONNECTION via nephew Jacqui Safra — Edge Foundation dinners with Epstein/Bezos/Gates (2012-14), Jerusalem property offered to Lauder (Mega Group) then Epstein, bank loan difficulties offered as financial opportunity. (5) MADOFF: Safra banks served as both conduit and victim. (6) 70 Safra entities in ICIJ offshore leaks, entire offshore infrastructure absorbed by HSBC 1999. (7) Ron Soffer worked at RNB 1988-91, bridging Safra world to Epstein legal network. Peter A. Cohen identified as bridge between Safra empire and Wall Street. Zero RNB documents in Epstein's 331K-page DOJ corpus — connection runs through family social network, not institutional banking.
RNB handled many Enterprise wire transfers per Walsh Report AND later adopted exemplary KYC policies per 2001 Levin PSI report (before HSBC acquisition)
findings.detail: Two contrasting references: (1) Walsh Report p.221 fn.20: RNB 'handled many of the Enterprise's wire transfers' for Iran-Contra. This means the bank processed covert financial flows for a secret US government operation involving illegal arms sales and contra funding. (2) Levin PSI Correspondent Banking Report (2001), p.30: Republic National Bank of New York (now HSBC USA) was cited as a 'notable exception' for its 'Know Your Customer Policy Statement' adopted for its International Banking Group, effective Dec 31, 1998. This KYC policy may have been adopted specifically because of lessons from the Iran-Contra and forfeiture experience. Edmond Safra founded RNB; he also controlled Trade Development Bank in Geneva where the Codelis account was held.

findings.summary: RNB handled Enterprise wire transfers AND had an officer coordinating off-book cash deliveries
findings.detail: Republic National Bank of New York (founded by Edmond Safra 1966, 452 Fifth Avenue) played a dual role in Iran-Contra: (1) It handled many of the Enterprise's legitimate wire transfers as a banking institution, and (2) one of its officers (Nan Morabia) coordinated an off-the-books cash delivery operation outside bank channels. Per Walsh Report, Morabia stated the cash-delivery operation was conducted by her outside bank channels. This is a critical distinction -- RNB's institutional role in wire transfers was separate from the Morabia family's personal cash operation, though the two were connected through Zucker's coordination. RNB was later acquired by HSBC in 1999 for $10.3B. Key RNB personnel per LittleSis: Edmond J. Safra (Founder 1966), Ezra Safra (employee), Jeffrey C. Keil (Vice Chairman 1984-1996), Theodore W. Kheel (Chairman 1966-1975), Meade H. Esposito (VP). RNB also had offshore entities in Guernsey and Panama.

findings.summary: RNB was America's largest gold bullion dealer -- critical context for Iran-Contra cash operations
findings.detail: Republic National Bank was the first American bank licensed to sell gold for industrial purposes. After the 1974 lifting of the private gold ownership ban, RNB became the nation's leading importer of gold coins and a major gold bullion dealer. This precious metals expertise is critical context: (1) The Safra family began as precious metals traders in Ottoman Aleppo, Syria. (2) RNB's gold trading made it expert in physical cash and commodity handling. (3) An officer at America's largest gold bank facilitating six-figure cash deliveries suggests institutional competence in physical asset transfers. (4) RNB was the 11th largest bank in the US. The bank's culture of physical precious metals trading may have normalized the handling of large amounts of physical cash.
